raw_segments.text: Antonio, I pray you, think you question with the Jew.
You may as well go stand upon the beach and bid the main floodbait his usual height.
You may as well use question with the wolf, why he hath made the ewe bleat for the lamb.
You may as well forbid the mountain pines to wag their high tops and to make no noise
when they are fretting with the gusts of heaven.
You may as well do anything most hard to seek to soften that, than which what's harder,
Therefore, I do beseech you, make no moe offers, use no farther means, but with all
Let me have judgment, and the Jew his will.
